title: MoonPay Launches PayBox for AI Transactions on Solana
description: MoonPay, a popular cryptocurrency platform, has recently launched PayBox, a new feature enabling AI transactions on the Solana blockchain.

Moonpay Menyediakan Layanan Penyimpanan Aman bagi Pengguna Claude dan ChatGPT yang Dapat Mengubah Perintah Menjadi Transaksi Pembayaran

sections.heading: MoonPay's PayBox Introduction
paragraphs: MoonPay has announced the launch of PayBox, a new service that facilitates AI transactions on the Solana blockchain, according to Pluang.

sections.heading: Purpose of PayBox
paragraphs: PayBox is designed to allow users to convert commands into payment transactions, as reported by Bitcoin News.

sections.heading: Security and Convenience
paragraphs: The service is aimed at providing a secure storage solution for users of Claude and ChatGPT, ensuring the safety of their transactions, as mentioned by Bitcoin News.

faq.a: PayBox is a service by MoonPay that enables AI transactions on the Solana blockchain, allowing users to convert commands into payment transactions.
PayBox is designed for users of Claude and ChatGPT, offering them a secure storage solution for their transactions.
